name: Kira Marie Peter-Hansen - Après le § 22 - Am 9
title: REPORT on European Semester for economic policy coordination 2026
part_text: 22a. Regrets that, in the context of a general reduction in public spending, multinational companies have for years benefited from significant public subsidies without conditions attached; calls, therefore, for such subsidies to be made conditional on clear social, economic and environmental commitments, including the preservation of local jobs and production, the achievement of ecological objectives, and limits on shareholder payouts and executive remuneration;
